ideas.title: Investigating COVID Fraud Schemes
ideas.description: This story would investigate COVID fraud schemes, including the recent conviction of a Minnesota non-profit leader who pilfered $250M meant for underserved children.
questions: What other COVID fraud schemes are being investigated?
How can we prevent similar schemes in the future?
ideas.insight: This story is significant as it highlights the need for increased oversight and accountability in COVID-related funding. By investigating COVID fraud schemes, we can identify potential patterns and connections between entities and programs.
